verdict.rationale: Google's GitHub project publishes open-source one-time passcode generator implementations for several mobile platforms, implementing HOTP and TOTP, so some seed-handling client code can be inspected. Nothing in the pack shows that the currently shipping Authenticator apps are built from that source, including the newer Google Account sync and Privacy Screen features. Missing for 10: evidence that the current client apps are open source, evidence of active community review, coverage of the sync and seed-storage code paths.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed

citations.quote: The Google Authenticator project includes implementations of one-time passcode generators for several mobile platforms.
These implementations support the HMAC-Based One-time Password (HOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 4226 and the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 6238.
